name: Elon
title: Judge in Israel
summary: Elon was a judge in Israel from the tribe of Zebulun who led the people for ten years. He is one of the so-called 'minor judges' in the Book of Judges, and little is known about his deeds beyond his period as judge and his burial place.

keyEvents.title: Becomes Judge in Israel
keyEvents.description: After Ibzan, Elon from Zebulun became judge in Israel and led the people for ten years.

keyEvents.title: Ten Years of Service
keyEvents.description: Elon judged Israel for ten years, a period that appears to have been marked by relative peace and stability.

keyEvents.title: The Death and Burial of Elon
keyEvents.description: When Elon died, he was buried in Aijalon in the territory of the tribe of Zebulun.
